articles.title: “Rubbing salt into Sikhs’ wounds”: BJP MP Tarun Chugh hits out at Sam Pitroda over 1984 anti-Sikh riots remarks
articles.description: Bharatiya Janata Party BJP MP Tarun Chugh on Thursday accused Indian Overseas Congress Chairman Sam Pitroda of rubbing salt into Sikhs wounds over his remarks on the 1984 anti-Sikh riots alleging that he was attempting to defend the Gandhi family and justify the violence Reacting to Pitrodas comments Chugh said that the Congress party had provided shelter to those accused in the riots and had failed to address the suffering of the victims He also criticised Pitroda for suggesting that the incident had taken place 40 years ago and should be forgotten
